content.title: The Governance of AI Firms
content.abstract: The leading developers of artificial intelligence (AI) are among the most valuable and influential companies in the world, yet their corporate governance has received little attention in the literature on AI governance. We contribute to filling this gap by comparing the governance of four leading AI firms (OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX and Alphabet/Google) and, more briefly, Mistral, Meta and DeepSeek.
